portable_recurrence_guards: Do not combine repository status traversal and multiple JSON parses in one PowerShell probe for this large owner lane.
After a shell-level timeout with no output, avoid adding Git-dir and process enumeration to the same recovery surface.
Do not infer repository corruption from a shell transport that cannot return even a scalar marker.
One failed no-login literal-marker probe is the terminal diagnostic for this shell surface; do not replay it during the phase.
